tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.flavor: Blood does not remain on the crown. It remains with the wearer.
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.passive.1: -Kill an enemy with a melee attack to heal 20% of maximum health and permanently gain 1 Max Health.
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.passive.2: -Taking damage reduces the Blood Blessing cooldown by 1 second.
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.passive.4: -While worn, each living kill grants +1 permanent Max Health (max 40 stacks).
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.passive.5: -Kill-earned health is bound to the player permanently and remains after unequipping.
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.passive.6: -After taking no damage for 3 seconds, regenerate 2 HP per second.
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.stat.3: Melee attacks restore 1.5% Max Health (1s cooldown)
tooltip.thecrowns.bloody_crown.stat.4: -After taking no damage for 3 seconds, regenerate 2 health per second.
tooltip.thecrowns.burning_crown.flavor: Flame cannot consume you; it consumes those who reach for you instead.
-When hit, retaliate with flame that deals 3 damage and burns the attacker for 4 seconds.
-Each point of Armor adds 0.4 damage; each point of Armor Toughness adds 0.5 seconds of burn time.
Fire duration: 4s + (current Armor Toughness × 0.5s), 1.5s cooldown per target.
-Immune to Poison, Wither, Slowness, and Nausea.
tooltip.thecrowns.crown_of_light.flavor: Full light answers most strongly to those who remain unbroken.
tooltip.thecrowns.crown_of_light.passive: Above 50% health, gain the following buffs:
tooltip.thecrowns.darkened_crown.flavor: Darkness does not blind you. It simply demands a price.
tooltip.thecrowns.darkened_crown.passive: -Every 8 seconds, completely evade the next incoming attack.
-Wardens do not target you unless you attack them first. Affinity returns after that Warden is no longer angry at you.
tooltip.thecrowns.shadow_crown.passive.1: -Shadow Hook: Ignore all forced movement and knockback not caused by yourself.
tooltip.thecrowns.shadow_crown.passive.2: -One with Darkness: After 8 seconds without attacking or being attacked, enter absolute invisibility.
tooltip.thecrowns.shadow_crown.passive.3: While invisible, you and your armor are fully hidden, and enemies within 50 blocks do not target you.
tooltip.thecrowns.shadow_crown.passive.4: Attacking or taking enemy damage ends invisibility. Environmental damage, such as fall damage, does not.
tooltip.thecrowns.shadow_crown.passive.5: -Ambush: While invisible, your melee and projectile attacks deal 4× final damage.
-All aquatic creatures are friendly to you and do not retaliate when attacked.
-Breathe underwater. After 3 seconds without combat while touching water, regenerate 1 health per second.
-While in water, Attack Damage, Armor, and Movement Speed increase by 25%.
With water within 20 blocks, Attack Damage, Armor, and Movement Speed increase by 15%.
If the nearest water is at least 10 blocks away, this increase is reduced to 10%.
tooltip.thecrowns.dimensional_crown.flav: A fold in space lets harm slip past and stacks the next strike upon itself.
tooltip.thecrowns.dimensional_crown.pass: -30% chance to nullify damage received from enemies.
-Dimensional Strike: Every 12 seconds, the next final damage you deal is tripled.
-A successful evade reduces the empowered-strike cooldown by 1 second.
-Ignore void damage; below Y -500, return to the sky and gain 30 seconds of fall-damage immunity.
-Enemies detect you from only half their normal range.
-Ignore void damage; below Y -500, return to the sky at the same X/Z and gain 30 seconds of fall-damage immunity.
-Monsters have 50% less effective range when first acquiring you as a target.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.active.1: -Fires a beam through 50 blocks, dealing 65% of target max health. Non-player targets can never heal above the health fraction left by the ray.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.active.1.dyna: -Fires a piercing beam straight ahead that deals fixed damage equal to %s%% of target max health. Non-player targets can never heal above the health fraction left by the ray.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.active.title: Active Ability: Disassembly Ray
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.detail.1: Reflective Barrier: On hit, damage is reduced by 80%. Up to 30 stacks are stored, and 1 stack regenerates every 10 seconds.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.detail.4: Nullifies the hurt immunity of hostile entities within 30 blocks and instantly executes entities brought to 10% HP or lower.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.detail.6: On lethal damage, fully restores your health and grants 5 seconds of invulnerability. Cooldown: 300 seconds.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.flavor: The PvP-restrained form of the Glitched Crown
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.passive.5: -Nullifies nearby enemies' hurt immunity and forcefully executes enemies at 10% HP or lower.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.passive.6: -When damaged, your barrier reduces the damage taken by 80%.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.passive.7: -On lethal damage, fully restores your health and grants 5 seconds of invulnerability, then restores 50% of your barrier.
tooltip.thecrowns.glitched.passive.8: -Instantly execute enemies within 30 blocks whose health is below 10% of maximum.
tooltip.thecrowns.ironforged_crown.activ: -On summon, it inherits 50% of the summoner's current Max Health, Armor, and Armor Toughness.
-The Iron Golem gains additional Attack Damage equal to 30% of its Armor plus 60% of its Armor Toughness.
-Damage from a single hit is capped at 10% of its maximum health.
-While the Crown is worn, the Iron Golem shares half of the summoner's incoming damage.
tooltip.thecrowns.ironforged_crown.flavo: A crown forged from iron raises a guardian in place of a king.
tooltip.thecrowns.pack_configurable: Pack-configurable: current server settings can alter these abilities and values.
tooltip.thecrowns.passive.title: Passive Abilities:
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.1: -Deletion Beam: Fires a beam that passes through blocks and entities. Entities touched by the beam collapse immediately.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.2: -Veil of Oblivion: Slip behind the world so no target can perceive you.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.3: -Power of the End: Wrap yourself in world-destroying power, making every attack overwhelmingly lethal.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.3.com: Both stages grant +100 Armor Pierce, 100% Protection Shred, and absolutely bind targets for 5 seconds on hit.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.3.ful: 100%: Final Damage ×%s / Attack Speed +%s / Attack Damage +%s
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.3.hal: 50%: Final Damage ×%s / Attack Speed +%s / Attack Damage +%s
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.active.title: Active Abilities:
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.3: Destroy the invulnerability of every nearby enemy.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.4: Ignore all forced movement not caused by your own will.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.5: The deletion beam deals 100% max-health damage, collapses health to zero, then forces kill() (G).
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.6: Wrap yourself in the Power of the End, making every attack overwhelmingly lethal (toggle with H).
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.7: Veil of Oblivion hides you behind the world, blocking mob detection and tracking (toggle with J).
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.8: While worn, all external interference with the Crown itself is nullified; any responsible entity is immediately erased.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.detail.9: A golden annihilation surface expands to 75 blocks over 3 seconds, erasing unprotected non-player entities it reaches (K).
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.flavor: The original unleashed Crown, wrapped in ominous violet flame
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.passive.1: -Be free from darkness, hunger, and the need to breathe.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.passive.3: -Nullify every invulnerability effect on nearby enemies.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed.passive.7: -Ignore all damage and never die. (Unless threatened by another Unleashed Crown!)
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed_unleashed.co: Uses an immutable full-power ruleset and ignores server Config values.
tooltip.thecrowns.unleashed_unleashed.cr: Admin Only — no recipe or advancement.
tooltip.thecrowns.warrior_crown.active.1: -Completely ignore all damage except direct melee damage.
tooltip.thecrowns.warrior_crown.active.3: -Cast while looking at a target to mark it with Slowness II, Weakness II, and Blindness II.
tooltip.thecrowns.warrior_crown.active.4: -Killing the marked target while the mark lasts reduces the cooldown by 30 seconds.
tooltip.thecrowns.warrior_crown.active.5: -Gain Strength II for the duration of Duel.
tooltip.thecrowns.warrior_crown.active.6: -When Duel nullifies damage, the knockback from that attack is also ignored.
-You cannot deal any damage that is not direct melee damage.

tooltip.thecrowns.frost_crown.passive.1: Ignore freezing damage, powder snow, and all slowing effects.
tooltip.thecrowns.frost_crown.passive.2: Creatures of cold places do not become hostile to you.
